svg.title: A terminal publishing a page while a browser shows it change: the card shelf and the changes feed trade places, revert, and one card is rewritten — each a single nubbin publish, with no deploy and no restart. A compatibility check then refuses a block version four live pages depend on.

g.text: # an editor swaps the two columns — moveNode, twice, then publish
# rewrite one card — setNodeProp on a title and a summary
5 live route pointer(s) checked; every one is compatible with this registry.
# someone bumps the version of a block four of those pages use
4 of 5 live route pointer(s) are incompatible with this registry:
Card: page needs v1, registry has v2
Card: page needs v1, registry has v2
the shelf on the left, the changes feed on the right
same blocks, different slots — no deploy, no restart
the harbour wall card now reads differently
